items.item: The form is split into titled sections (personal, job and contract, bank and tax, emergency contact, documents) in a single column, with a visible label above every field and no placeholder-only labels
items.evidence: Five <section data-step-panel="1..5"> blocks each with an <h2> title ('Personal details', 'Job & contract', 'Bank & tax information', 'Emergency contact', 'Documents'); fields stack in a single column (minor 2-col pairing only for firstName/lastName and city/postalCode); every input has a <label for=...> above it (e.g. <label for="email">Personal email</label>) and preferredName's placeholder text is supplementary to its real label, not a substitute.

items.item: Required fields are marked consistently, and optional fields are labelled as optional or left unmarked by a stated convention
items.evidence:
Top of form states convention: '

* Required

'. Every required input's label ends with '*' (firstName, lastName, dob, nationalId, email, phone, address, jobTitle, etc.); optional fields (preferredName, gender, city, postalCode, probationEnd, socialInsurance, dependents, ecEmail, ecAddress, degree/bankLetter uploads) consistently carry no asterisk.

items.item: Field widths match their content: dates, postal codes and tax codes are narrow; inputs use the right types (email, tel, date)
items.evidence: dob/startDate/probationEnd use type="date" class="h-8 w-40"; postalCode is class="h-8 w-28"; taxCode/nationalId/accountNumber are capped at w-56/w-64 rather than full width; email field is type="email", phone/ecPhone are type="tel", dependents is type="number".

items.item: An option to save the form as a draft is offered, and saving a draft does not demand every required field
items.evidence: button#draft-btn onclick="saveDraft()"; saveDraft() only toggles the draft pill/toast and sets isDirty=false — it never calls collectErrors()/validateField(), so it does not enforce required fields.

items.item: Save and Cancel stay reachable while scrolling (a sticky bar or equivalent), Save is a verb label and is not disabled before submitting
items.evidence: <div class="sticky bottom-0 flex items-center justify-end gap-3 border-t border-border bg-card px-6 py-3"> contains Cancel, Save draft and button#save-btn labelled 'Create employee' (verb); save-btn has no disabled attribute at load, only set disabled:true transiently inside submitForm()'s 1200ms mock request.

items.item: Fields validate on blur and on submit; with several errors a summary at the top links to each field and focus moves to the first invalid field
items.evidence: Required inputs get `el.addEventListener('blur', () => validateField(name,label))`; submitForm() calls collectErrors() (re-runs validateField for all required fields/uploads); renderErrorSummary() shows #error-summary with <a href="#name" onclick="jumpToField(...)"> links once errors.length>=3; submitForm() always calls jumpToField(errors[0].name) which does goToStep + el.focus() on the first invalid field.

items.item: Leaving the page with unsaved input triggers a warning
items.evidence: window.addEventListener('beforeunload', ...) calls e.preventDefault()/sets e.returnValue when isDirty; additionally Cancel button (handleCancel()) opens a custom 'You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?' dialog (#leave-dialog) when isDirty is true.

items.item: The document upload states accepted file types and the size limit, lists chosen files with a remove button, and is keyboard operable
items.evidence: Accepted types/size are stated ('Accepted file types: PDF, JPG or PNG. 10 MB per file maximum.') and uploaded files are listed (data-upload-name shows 'id_front_back.pdf · 1.2 MB'), but there is no remove/delete control anywhere — mockUpload() only re-renders 'Preview' and 'Replace' buttons, never a Remove option. The actual file picker is also not keyboard operable: `<input type="file" class="hidden" onchange="mockUpload(...)">` is display:none (removed from tab order) and is wrapped only in a plain `<label>` with no tabindex, so it cannot be reached or activated by keyboard.

items.item: Success is confirmed with a message that names the employee and is announced to assistive technology
items.evidence: submitForm()'s success path calls showToast('Employee Trần Thị Thu Hà created'); #toast has role="status" aria-live="polite", so the named-employee message is announced to assistive technology.

notes: Form is implemented as a 5-step wizard (stepper with goToStep()) rather than one continuously-scrollable page with all sections visible at once; each step is still a clearly titled single-column section so the sections/labels checklist item was scored a pass. No classic AI-dashboard template tells (no greeting header, KPI tiles, gradients, glass panels, uppercase tracked labels, emoji icons, decorative sidebar, or oversized radii) were found — this reads as a genuine enterprise form build. The only real failure is the Documents step: no way to remove an already-selected file, and the hidden file inputs (display:none, only wrapped in a non-focusable <label>) are not keyboard operable.
